shop3d.title: 3D store
shop3d.loginTitle: Sign in to visit the 3D store
shop3d.loginText: The 3D store is for registered customers. Sign in to your account or create one.
shop3d.limitTitle: Your time for today is over
shop3d.limitText: You can spend {minutes} minutes a day in the 3D store and you have used it today. Come back tomorrow; the product list is always available.
shop3d.errorText: We could not check your access. Please try again in a moment.
shop3d.launcherText: Push a trolley between the shelves, look at the products and do all your shopping right there. The store opens full screen with the bottom menu, and the "Back to page" button (or your phone's Back key) returns you to this page.
shop3d.launcherF1: Drive the trolley and browse the shelves
shop3d.launcherF2: Pick products from the offers wall and the search
shop3d.launcherF3: Pay at the store's checkout counter
shop3d.tourTouch: On a phone: joystick at the bottom left = drive, drag the scene = look around, two fingers = zoom, tap the floor = go there, "Aisles" button = pick products easily without aiming.
shop3d.tipPick: Tip: click a product, or a row on the offers wall, and add it to your trolley.
shop3d.tipCheckout: Your trolley is ready; click the counter to pay.
shop3d.tour1Text: Use W and S to go forward and back, and A and D (or the left and right arrows) to steer; the trolley rolls on a little, like a real one. On a phone use the buttons at the bottom left. Try it now!
shop3d.tour2Text: Drag with the mouse or your finger to look at the shelves on either side; the trolley keeps its heading. Press C (or the ● button) to look ahead again. Look down to see inside the trolley.
shop3d.tour3Text: Click any product to open its card and press Add to drop it in the trolley. The "Where is...?" box or the small map takes you straight to a shelf.
shop3d.tour4Text: Your trolley has driven to the offers wall. Click a row to select that product and add it to the trolley.
shop3d.tour5Text: The red dot on the map in the corner is you (the gray line is the trolley's heading). Click an aisle to drive there.
shop3d.tour6Text: Click the counter (or the checkout button): the trolley drives there and you pay on the spot without leaving the store. You can change quantities there too.
shop3d.find: Find a product in the store
shop3d.noMatch: That product is not on the shelves.
shop3d.notOnShelf: That product is not on the 3D store shelves; please use the normal search.
shop3d.helpTitle: How to move around the store
shop3d.helpMove: Move: W A S D or the arrow keys (left/right arrows turn)
shop3d.helpLook: Look around: drag with the mouse or your finger
shop3d.helpWalk: Walk: click the floor or the small map
shop3d.helpPick: Pick: click a product and add it to your basket; pay at the counter
shop3d.map: Store map (click an aisle to go there)
shop3d.empty: No products to show in the 3D store yet.
